description: §19.10.5 / §8.9.2 E-BATCH-001 — a `!` server handler whose two `?{}` reads form an implicit per-handler transaction envelope AND which contains an explicit `transaction { }` block. Source-reachable since S450 (before it, `transaction { }` did not parse in a function body — see ../implicit-tx-explicit-begin/NOTES.md gap #1).
rationale: §19.10.5: "An implicit per-handler transaction SHALL NOT compose with an explicit `transaction { }` block in the same handler. The compiler SHALL emit E-BATCH-001 when both are present."
